name: CrewAI
shortDescription: Open-source framework for crews of role-based agents that split a job into tasks.
longDescription: CrewAI is the crew-style option in this catalog: you define roles and tasks, and the Python library coordinates them. The open-source framework and the hosted product are separate. The free cloud plan includes 50 workflow executions per month.
pricingNotes: Enterprise Custom. Open-source framework separate from cloud Free/Enterprise.
bestFor: Multi-step jobs you can split across roles
Python teams who want a crew abstraction they can install
notIdealFor: A single chat box with no workflow
Teams that only want a closed SaaS and will not touch Python
strength: CrewAI 1.15.28 is an open-source framework that splits a job across role-based agents.
weakness: The cloud free plan includes 50 workflow executions per month, and paid use above that is custom Enterprise pricing.

handsOn.detail: We installed version 1.15.28 and confirmed it loads. We did not sign up, pay, or run it on a real task.

useCaseFit.multi-agent-workflows: Open-source framework that splits one job across role-based agents.
